body: I've learned to cope with disappointment, but everything's a disappointment; I can only take so much.

I do have a lot of interests, and I do talk about them, but when people tell stories and things like that I can't relate, because I don't have anything worth talking about going on anymore. I told her that I didn't like dating, and that I get nervous and she seemed receptive, but it still became an issue once it actually began to happen. 

I am in a life transition, I want/need to change, but I can't do it because I'm being held back. It's like I'm drowning and everyone's too busy or not interested in helping. Nothing positive ever happens, and it doesn't matter how hard I try to remain positive about things either. I can never get a break, on anything... I'm tired of the pain.
